capabilities: search the web from a command palette modal
search selected editor text with a hotkey
insert results as formatted markdown with links, dates, and highlights
configure result count, highlights, full text extraction, and search type
copy results to the clipboard when no editor is open
extras: The community plugins listing is pending review; the README provides manual installation steps and states the API key is stored locally and used only for searches to api.exa.ai.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in web search, so users must leave the app to look things up and manually paste results into notes.

relations.evidence: Search the web with Exa directly from Obsidian and insert results into your notes.

summary: Web search integration that queries the Exa AI-native search engine from a command palette modal and inserts results as markdown into notes.
